test_title: PYST 04: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

"The mechanic may be checking the brakes now."

options.text: The brakes may be being checked now.
The brakes May be checking now.
The brakes may be check now.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "The mechanic may be checking the brakes now."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the brakes" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "may be checking" to "may be being checked" (present continuous passive).
 
• Ensure the time phrase "now" remains at the end of the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The brakes may be being checked now."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The brakes may checked now." – Incorrect structure (missing auxiliary verb).
 
• **Option 3: **"The brakes may be checking now." – Incorrect voice (active instead of passive).
 
• **Option 4: **"The brakes may be check now." – Incorrect verb form (missing auxiliary verb).
